subject: MAP Playbook: owners, milestones & path to close (initial draft)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@mediasync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, May 2, 2027 at 4:12 PM PDT
Subject: MAP Playbook: owners, milestones & path to close (initial draft)

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps + an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we have a concrete place to agree on owners and dates. Highlights from the discovery:

- Key goal: reduce inference cost by 40% while keeping 95th-percentile latency under 300ms for your customer-facing chat product.
- Main blockers you called out: SOC 2 evidence, integration window for the POC, and procurement timeline for a dedicated environment.

Attached: redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx — a short playbook with milestones, suggested owners, and two timeline options. Please review and confirm stakeholders for each milestone (we've guessed some owners below).

Initial milestone summary (high level):
- M1: Security & Compliance sign-off — Owner (Alicia Gomez / MediaSync) — Dependency: SOC 2 evidence from Redwood (we've attached a short packet).
- M2: Integration POC (3rd-party connector + sample dataset) — Owner (MediaSync Eng / Redwood SE) — Dependency: access to sandbox and data schema.
- M3: Performance validation & cost model — Owner (Jordan / Redwood Solutions) — Dependency: POC results and token distribution sample.
- M4: Contracting & procurement — Owner (Jordan + MediaSync procurement) — Dependency: final SOW and pricing option selection.

Options for target close (pick one or propose another):
- Option A (Aggressive): 6–8 weeks — prioritize resources, compressed security review.
- Option B (Conservative): 10–12 weeks — normal procurement cadence and staged rollout.

Ask: please confirm: (1) the stakeholder list for each milestone, (2) preferred target close option, and (3) any other dependencies we missed.

Attachments: redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, security_requirements.pdf

Thanks — I can circulate a revised MAP once you confirm stakeholders.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0187 | tessa_morgan@redwood.com

From: Jordan Lee <jordan@mediasync.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, May 2, 2027 at 6:03 PM PDT
Subject: Re: MAP Playbook: owners, milestones & path to close (initial draft)

Thanks Tessa — great summary and appreciate the MAP draft. A few notes from my side after syncing quickly with our ops and procurement leads: 

- Confirming stakeholders: Alicia Gomez (Security & Compliance) will be the primary on our side for M1. I'll be the exec sponsor and coordinate procurement. I'll loop in Miguel Santos (Principal Engineer) for M2/PT integration; his email is miguel@mediasync.io.
- SOC 2: we'll need the SOC2 Type II report or a point-in-time attestation — the packet you sent helps but procurement expects an attestation date. Can you point me to the attestation or confirm timing?
- Integration POC: Miguel wants the sandbox credentials and sample schema by next week if we target the aggressive timeline. Is that feasible?

One more ask: can you call out which milestones require Redwood SE vs. Redwood Eng involvement? That will help us schedule Miguel and Alicia.

I'll review the MAP spreadsheet tonight and get back with any changes to ownership.

Best,
Jordan
VP Product, MediaSync
jordan@mediasync.io

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@mediasync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@healthhub.co>
Date: Tue, May 3, 2027 at 8:21 AM PDT
Subject: Re: MAP Playbook: owners, milestones & path to close (initial draft)

Jordan — thanks for the quick sync and for naming Miguel and Alicia. I've updated the MAP summary inline below (also updated the spreadsheet link). I called out who from Redwood we'd expect to own each milestone. Please review and confirm or correct owners.

Updated milestone table (summary):
- M1: Security & Compliance sign-off
  - Proposed owners: Alicia Gomez (MediaSync), Marissa Cole (Redwood — Head of Trust & Security)
  - Target: if attestation available -> 1 week review; otherwise allow 3 weeks for documentation + follow-up (dependency influences timeline choice)
  - Attachments: security_requirements.pdf

- M2: Integration POC (sandbox, connector, sample dataset)
  - Proposed owners: Miguel Santos (MediaSync Eng), Monica Patel (Redwood SE)
  - Target: Aggressive = 2 weeks for POC setup + 1 week run; Conservative = 4 weeks setup + 2 weeks run
  - Dependencies: sandbox access + schema + sample payloads

- M3: Performance validation & cost model
  - Proposed owners: Jordan Lee (MediaSync), Tessa Morgan (Redwood Solutions)
  - Target: 1 week after POC completion (both timelines)

- M4: Contracting & procurement (SOW + pricing)
  - Proposed owners: Jordan Lee (MediaSync), Redwood Sales (Marissa Cole)
  - Target: aligned with chosen timeline; include a 1-week legal review buffer

Two timeline options (for your selection):
- Option A — Aggressive: 6 weeks total
  - Assumes SOC attestation available or prioritized evidence delivery; SE focused support and pre-approved SOW template.
- Option B — Conservative: 10 weeks total
  - Assumes standard procurement cadence and staged validation windows.

Action items I can take next (if you confirm stakeholders):
1) Share sandbox access request template and kickoff ticket for your infra team. (Link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/rdw-4532/MAP-v1)
2) Marissa will prepare the attestation packet and point the SOC 2 date (Marissa — can you confirm availability to join Alicia's review?).
3) I'll circulate an updated MAP (v1.1) with dates once we get stakeholder confirmation and your preferred timeline option.

Please reply with: (A) stakeholder confirmations, and (B) Option A or B (or a custom timeline). Happy to hop on a 20-minute follow-up if useful (I'm free Wed morning).

Thanks — Tessa

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, May 3, 2027 at 9:34 AM PDT
Subject: Re: MAP Playbook: owners, milestones & path to close (initial draft)

Internal note — tagging quickly so we can move: 

Marissa / Monica — quick asks from my side based on Jordan's response: 
- Marissa: can you pull the latest SOC 2 attestation/summary and a short cover note we can send to MediaSync procurement? They asked for attestation timing specifically (point-in-time). If you can confirm availability to be on the compliance call with Alicia this week that would be great.
- Monica: please prepare the POC checklist (sandbox request, sample schema, SE runbook) and a rough resource estimate (SE hours) in the MAP v1.1. Miguel asked for sandbox creds by next week if we go Aggressive.

I'll hold off sending v1.1 externally until I have your confirmations — target to push v1.1 by EOD today if feasible. Let me know if you need me to loop Legal.

— Tessa
